title: Lantern Drift
summary: A cozy dodge challenge around a campfire where lanterns drift and hazards block your path.
instructions: Move with arrow keys or A / D to avoid drifting lanterns and protect the campfire.

overlay.startCopy: Dodge drifting lanterns around the campfire, stay in motion, and keep the night safe.

help.title: How To Start Campfire Cozy Dodge Lanterns
steps: Press Start in the center overlay.
Use the controls: Move with arrow keys or A / D to avoid drifting lanterns and protect the campfire.
Follow the first goal: dodge through campfire.
